body:
Integrator assessment (read-only; no code, no merge, no mutation, no cargo), 2026-11-01 ~01:35 PDT.

Forge heads (ls-remote): 3177=7044b343, 3198=fa636d0a, 3190=26d4cd35. main=ac1e3180. Live train PR 3200 (#3197+#3195) head f9efee18, CI still PENDING. I did not touch it and updated no branch.

PR 3177: ELIGIBLE.
- Verdict APPROVED at 7044b343 by claude-reviewer-857 (reviewer seat, own grant 90dd5dbd). The implementer commit a6360cea comes from a separate session, so authorship is independent.
- The hold was released by verdict at 7044 (ledger seq26, auto-released:verdict). No local marker. merge-hold-gate run 41288090392 passes.
- All shards and Build pass at head. `aida pr list` still shows "Failing" from the old merge-hold-gate red. That is stale.
- Two minor findings, non-blocking: fetch-kill ref-lock, and forecast cost.
- The spec is supervised per the verdict, so it needs a human terminal naming the PR.

PR 3198: ELIGIBLE.
- APPROVED at fa636d0a by the claude reviewer seat (grant 798e2901). The author is codex, so the review is cross-vendor independent.
- No hold ever recorded. merge-hold-gate passes. All shards and Build pass.
- One minor finding, non-blocking: the python e2e probe is not in CI. AC3 is still covered by the Rust test. Accepted on the spec.

PR 3190: ELIGIBLE, with a caveat.
- Run 41285928470 at 26d4: after the failed-job rerun, all shards (gates included) and Build pass. The earlier red was story_1917_..._without_merging taking 10.2s against a 10s limit, a timing flake. No test was suppressed.
- Approval: the independent reviewer-seat APPROVE is at e209953d (grant 08156b8c). The 26d4 record is an ADVISOR-seat carry-over (grant 9fe860d7). It has the same patch_id f16940ec, and 26d4 is a pure merge-from-main.
- So the train gate's "approval carried over a clean merge from main" plus its patch-id check rest on the independent e209953 review. Do not count the advisor record as the review. If the tool rejects the carry, the remedy is a fresh independent reviewer at 26d4.
- The hold was released at e209953 (seq10), and nothing later. Both findings are minor and non-blocking.
- Status needs-attention is left over from the red-Build comment. It is not a hold.
- Note the spurious linkage "shipped=true commit=53c89700b4d" (TASK-2631) on BUG-2381. Re-check it after landing.

Stacking risk: the only file shared across 3177, 3198, 3190 and train 3200 is cli_help_snapshot.txt, between 3198 and 3200. The hunks do not overlap.
- The merge-tree probe was blocked because the sandbox makes git objects read-only. So this is file and hunk overlap only.
- If 3198 drops out as conflicting or diff-changed, it needs doer rework plus a new independent review. No waiver.

Prepared command, for the authorized operator terminal ONLY after 3200 has landed or ended:
  aida pr train 3190 3177 3198
(3198 goes last for snapshot adjacency. Optionally run --dry-run first.) No holds waived. Nothing claimed about pending CI.
subject: Integrator assessment: 3177/3198/3190 eligible; train cmd after 3200
